title: anatomy_run
description: What one solver run is asked to solve: one anatomy, one body parameter set and a list of poses. Written by the anatomy authoring side; the solver's answer is an anatomy_result (REFACTOR/ANATOMY_EXCHANGE.md).

$schema.description: The schema this document follows, by its `$id`: the last path segment names the file in husk's schema/ directory, and schema_version says which version of it (REFACTOR/BUNDLE_FORMAT.md "The contract header").

schema_version.description: Version of the anatomy family's schemas this document conforms to (REFACTOR/ANATOMY_EXCHANGE.md invariant 6).

subject.description: The run, by the name its author gave it.

space.description: Units and axes of every value in the document.

coordinates.description: The order of every pose's values: one entry per base-model joint coordinate the run drives. A base-model joint left out keeps its default.

selection.description: The body and the poses to solve it at.

body.description: The body parameter set: a value per parameter of the anatomy; a parameter not listed is solved at its rest value.

poses.description: The poses to solve, in the order a sweep runs them.

id.description: The pose's name, unique among the poses; a result names its requested poses by it.

values.description: One value per entry of definition.coordinates, in that order.

references.description: The anatomy the run is of, and nothing else.

coordinate.description: One driven joint coordinate of the base model.

id.description: The base-model joint's name. Only one-coordinate joints are driven (MJCF hinge and slide), so a joint is one coordinate; a ball or free joint has none here.

unit.description: The unit of this coordinate's values: radian for a hinge, metre for a slide.

parameter.description: The parameter, by its id in the referenced anatomy's definition.parameters.

value.description: The value, in the unit the parameter's quantity states.
value.x-unit: 1 or metre, by the parameter's quantity
